Trim and collapse whitespace in the Register Address text, preserving it as a whole address for the fund subject without parsing components.

unmapped_fields.reason: Trustee subject, not the fund subject; no fund-subject entity field is supported for this value.
Trustee ABN belongs to the trustee subject, not the fund subject, so it cannot be mapped to entity.abn for the fund.
Fund Status uses regulatory status text such as Complying that is not directly equivalent to the canonical status enum.
Fund Type is a regulatory classification with no canonical entity_type equivalent in the ontology subset.

Contact Telephone Number has no supported canonical target in the ontology subset.

Employer Name belongs to an employer subject, not the fund subject.
Employer ABN belongs to an employer subject, not the fund subject.
